titleEn: A forecast, an overrun, and circulating it
canDoYue: 你識問預測超支可唔可以改星期一審核、傳閱書面預測，同新議程點寫。
canDoEn: Talk about a forecast, a cost overrun, circulating a note, and the stakeholders.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we please move the Monday review if the forecast shows an overrun before Friday?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果預測喺星期五之前顯示超支，可唔可以改星期一嘅審核？
dialogue.say: Could we please move the Monday review if the forecast shows an overrun before Friday?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: We can move that Monday review, and the forecast still shows a small cost overrun.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋可以改嗰個星期一審核，預測仍然顯示少少成本超支。
dialogue.say: We can move that Monday review, and the forecast still shows a small cost overrun.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will you circulate the written forecast if each stakeholder has not read the note yet?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果每個持份者未睇過張字條，你會唔會傳閱書面預測？
dialogue.say: Will you circulate the written forecast if each stakeholder has not read the note yet?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will circulate that written forecast once the team has read the full note pack.
dialogue.glossYue: 團隊睇完成份字條，我就會傳閱嗰份書面預測。
dialogue.say: I will circulate that written forecast once the team has read the full note pack.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What should the new written agenda say if the overrun changes the Monday review date?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果超支改咗星期一審核日期，新書面議程應該點寫？
dialogue.say: What should the new written agenda say if the overrun changes the Monday review date?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will put the new date on the agenda and note the overrun after review.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會將新日期寫上議程，並喺審核之後記低超支。
dialogue.say: I will put the new date on the agenda and note the overrun after review.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you circulate the full agenda without those raw notes during the Monday call?
dialogue.glossYue: 星期一通話期間，可唔可以傳閱成份議程，但唔顯示嗰啲原始筆記？
dialogue.say: Can you circulate the full agenda without those raw notes during the Monday call?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will circulate the full agenda, and those raw notes stay inside the pack.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會傳閱成份議程，嗰啲原始筆記留喺文件包入面。
dialogue.say: I will circulate the full agenda, and those raw notes stay inside the pack.
